verdict.rationale: A sandbox or test environment is a fair question for Obsidian, since it has a plugin API and a headless Sync client aimed at agents and automated workflows, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows no first-party sandbox or test environment that isolates experiments from production vault data. Opening separate folders as separate vaults is a user-side workaround, and Restricted Mode is an adjacent control that blocks third-party code, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
